name: Question 3
problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14133144/assets/59ad2f481ad5a781f811877f569a0cc15cab372ad678be39d6a53c11f1d418a9.png)

What division problem is represented by the model above?
worked_solution:
We have $\frac{2}{5}$ on the left and $\frac{2}{15}$ on the right.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14133144/assets/441a813e225582ddd79d642763c789f2886b5dc17df692a7bd48dd8e3265082d.png)

Therefore, the division problem shown is

$$
\frac{2}{5}÷3=\frac{2}{15}.
$$
